summary.text: L.C. Myles is a Democratic state representative who has represented Georgia House District 126 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican William Harris.

paragraphs.text: Myles, listed by Ballotpedia as L.C. Myles Jr., defeated William Harris in the November 2024 general election for House District 126, succeeding Gloria Frazier, and took office on January 13, 2025.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Interstate Cooperation, Intragovernmental Coordination, and Public Safety and Homeland Security committees.
